app.name: CiftPay
app.tagline: Get paid on M-Pesa. Issue the KRA invoice before you put your phone down.

common.offline: You're offline. Showing what we saved last time.
common.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
common.noConnection: Can't reach CiftPay right now. Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Enter the phone number registered with your business. We'll text you a 6-digit code.
login.phoneInvalid: That doesn't look like a Kenyan mobile number.
login.codeSentTo: Code sent to {msisdn}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
login.wrongCode: That code didn't match. Check the SMS and try again.
login.footer: By signing in you accept that CiftPay never holds your money — it only reads M-Pesa confirmations and files invoices with KRA on your behalf.

business.title: Your business
business.lead: The name and KRA PIN that go on every receipt.
business.name: Business name
business.nameHint: As buyers know it, e.g. Mama Njeri Wholesalers
business.pinHint: A or P, nine digits and a letter, e.g. P051234567X
business.pinInvalid: That isn't a KRA PIN. It starts with A or P and has eleven characters.
business.pinUnknown: KRA doesn't recognise this PIN. Check it on iTax and try again.
business.pinTaken: A business with this PIN is already on CiftPay. If it's yours, sign in with the phone that registered it.
business.vatHint: Tick if you charge 16% VAT. Leave it if you only pay turnover tax.

shortcode.title: Where do customers pay you?
shortcode.lead: Add the M-Pesa number you're paid on. Every payment to it becomes a KRA receipt.
shortcode.numberHintTill: The Till number on your Lipa na M-Pesa sticker, 5–7 digits
shortcode.label: Label (optional)
shortcode.labelHint: Helps when you have more than one, e.g. Shop, Kiosk
shortcode.claimed: This number is already verified by another business. If it's yours, contact support.

authorization.title: Authorization document
authorization.lead: Safaricom needs your written permission before it can send CiftPay the payment notifications for {shortcode}.

steps.print: Print the CiftPay Safaricom Authorization Letter.
steps.sign: Sign it as the registered owner.
steps.upload: Take a clear photo (or scan to PDF) and upload it here.

authorization.note: Safaricom checks the letter against the Till’s records and connects it to CiftPay. This usually takes 1–3 business days. You can use CiftPay meanwhile; M-Pesa payments start appearing once the Till is verified.
authorization.choose: Photo or PDF of the signed letter
authorization.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB.
authorization.fileTypeInvalid: That file type won’t work. Upload a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF.
authorization.fileTooLarge: That file is too big. Keep it under 10 MB.
authorization.fileRejected: CiftPay couldn’t read that file. Try a clearer photo or a PDF under 10 MB.
authorization.alreadyVerified: This number is already verified. Nothing more to do.
authorization.claimed: This number is already verified by another business. If it’s yours, write to support@ciftpay.co.ke.
authorization.submitted: Letter received. We'll email you once Safaricom confirms the mapping.

letter.title: CiftPay Safaricom Authorization Letter
letter.subject: Subject: Authorization to map M-Pesa short code {shortcode} to CiftPay
letter.body1: I, the undersigned, being the registered owner of the M-Pesa short code {shortcode}{label}, authorize Safaricom PLC to map this short code to CiftPay's Daraja application so that CiftPay may receive C2B payment confirmations for it on my business's behalf.
letter.body2: CiftPay does not hold or move my M-Pesa funds; it only reads payment notifications to prepare KRA eTIMS receipts.
letter.fillHint: Fields left blank are filled in by hand before signing.

today.title: Today
today.payments: {count, plural, =0 {No payments yet} one {# payment} other {# payments}}
today.emptyPayments: No M-Pesa payments yet today. The next one shows up here on its own.

payments.title: Payments
payments.empty: No M-Pesa payments here yet. The next one shows up on its own.
payments.convertTitle: Turn this payment into a KRA invoice
payments.convertLead: Pick what was sold. We'll file the invoice with KRA and text the buyer.
payments.buyerPinHint: Lets the buyer deduct this expense.
payments.converted: Invoice queued. KRA usually answers within a minute.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. Your first M-Pesa payment will create one.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.empty: Nothing needs you right now. Every payment has its invoice.
attention.unmatchedLead: We couldn't tell what {amount} from {msisdn} was for.
attention.unverifiedLead: Till {shortcode} isn’t verified yet. Upload the signed Safaricom authorization letter in Settings.
attention.pendingLongLead: KRA is slow right now. We'll keep trying and text the buyer when it's through.

items.title: Items
items.empty: No items yet. Add what you sell so invoices carry the right KRA code.
items.name: Name
items.codeHint: Search by what you sell, e.g. 'bread' or 'airtime'.
items.priceHint: VAT-inclusive. Leave empty to type it at sale time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.receiptLead: Buyers get an SMS with a link to a verifiable KRA receipt.

etims.title: KRA connection
etims.lead: Connect CiftPay directly to KRA eTIMS so your invoices are filed automatically. This is separate from M-Pesa — your sales are recorded either way.
etims.pendingNote: Sales are being recorded and will be filed with KRA automatically as soon as this is connected.
etims.deviceSerialHint: Issued by KRA, not by CiftPay.
etims.deviceSerialInvalid: Enter the device serial KRA gave you.
etims.branchIdInvalid: Branch ID must be two digits, e.g. 00.
etims.howTitle: Where do I get a device serial?
etims.how1: Sign up on the KRA eTIMS taxpayer portal with your business's KRA PIN.
etims.how2: Open a Service Request and choose OSCU (Online Sales Control Unit).
etims.how3: Once KRA approves the request, they give you a device serial. Enter it below.
etims.portalLink: Open the KRA eTIMS taxpayer portal

sale.title: Record a sale
sale.lead: For cash or a payment we didn't see. We'll file it with KRA right away.
sale.queued: Invoice queued. KRA usually answers within a minute.
sale.offlineQueued: Saved. We'll file it with KRA as soon as you're back online.

accountant.title: Clients
accountant.lead: Every client's M-Pesa income, already reconciled and fiscalised.
accountant.empty: No client businesses yet. Ask a merchant to add you as their accountant.

admin.title: Ops
admin.lead: Submissions stuck with KRA, org search, feature flags.
admin.empty: Nothing stuck. The queue is clear.

receipt.title: KRA receipt {code}
receipt.verifiedLead: KRA has this invoice on record. The number and signature above match KRA's copy.
receipt.pendingLead: The seller has filed this with KRA. It'll show as verified once KRA answers.
receipt.cancelledLead: This invoice was reversed. The credit note above cancels it.
receipt.cta: Issue your own eTIMS receipts — CiftPay
receipt.notFoundLead: Check the link in your SMS. Codes are 6 characters, like 7KQ2M9.
